name: dynlight-data-chunk1343
note: Actor light definitions, the Dehacked type alias, and state-light binding from a_dynlightdata.cpp (1-304).
auditSeams: GetRealType asks for the replacement with a null level and skill lookup off, then keeps that replacement only when it is a different DehackedPickup descendant. GetAttenuate is the attenuate byte, so the default -1 still scales both intensities. ApplyProperties saves the previous light type, points the live light at the definition arguments and flags, and copies the offset last. A pulse reads FCycler::SetParams before that copy. Frame names occupy eight bytes. A frame index is stored when the name length is 5 or byte 5 is 0. AddStateLight stores the TArray push index in a 16-bit field and inserts NAME_None only when the state light is 0.
auditRationale: UNCredited a_dynlightdata.cpp 1-304 (+304). A full tally line scan shows no overlap. This whole file is the largest remaining hole of at most 400 lines, ahead of codegen.cpp 9535-9836.
auditUncreditedRangeCheck: uncredited_range_check.py --file src/r_data/a_dynlightdata.cpp --start 1 --end 304 and a full tally line scan → no overlap.
auditManagedLocJustification: FName folding, the eight-byte frame buffer, TArray push indexes, and FCycler::SetParams are defined outside this file. The managed port keeps them because ApplyProperties reads the cycler on the next line, AddStateLight stores the push index in a 16-bit field, and the association reads frame byte 5 whenever the stored length is not 5. Serializer field order and the empty-array skip are the rest of that host surface. That is why the managed file is over 150% of the 304-line source.
